lead: A `Core\Db\Schema` proof that writes its own `create table` has to spell each column type the way the dialect emitter writes it, or the plan opens with a whole-table rebuild.
body: A column declared `title text not null` against a schema saying `text(200)` is a *type change*, which SQLite cannot alter in place, so the diff grades it `Destructive` and a proof written to show one `Safe` step prints a create-copy-drop-rename in front of it. Write `varchar(200)`, and read the SQL of step one out of `planAgainst` once before blessing anything.
